errors: The `retries` option name is an assumption, though the answer flags it as one.
The 'Changes' section implies the retry default is the only change. It doesn't mention that more retries can mean longer waits before a failure surfaces.
The `on('error')` example calls `on` as a bare global function. It doesn't show it as a method on the SDK client, so it may mislead readers.
'Long-running apps will now use less memory' is a mild extrapolation beyond the stated fix.
